summary.text: Jacob Landry is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 49, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Iberia, Lafayette, and Vermilion parishes. First elected in 2023, Jacob Landry sits on the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Commerce, and Natural Resources and Environment committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Jacob Landry's occupation as business owner, and his education as Erath High School, the University of Louisiana at Lafayette, and the University of Southwestern Louisiana.

The House page lists Jacob Landry's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Commerce, Natural Resources and Environment, and Atchafalaya Basin Program Oversight Committee, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
